title: Why radar metrics are min-max scaled
pdf_question: Why were the metrics normalized to a 0-1 range before plotting on the radar chart, instead of using their original scales (e.g. review count 50-500 vs. average rating 0-5)?
graph_structure: 4 axes (count, rating, length, spoiler ratio), each min–max scaled to [0,1], one polygon per book
formulas: x_norm = (x - min) / (max - min)   if max != min else 0.5
